subject: stf
title: STF.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in WAM-32, paired with v1-p90-1, after Braxton describes serial music (on the preceding page) as connected to 'the source-transfer junction of world creativity' — i.e., as a moment where western art music becomes available for genuine cross-aesthetic transfer because its own composite alignment has dissolved. (C)STF (source transfer) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the diagram poses how source transfer would actually be constituted if it were to flow into progressional continuance rather than terminate as private composer-experiment. The main line runs from STF to the label drawn at its end, PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). STF also branches into TR-INFO (trans-information) → AFTD (affinity tendencies) → ATTN (attraction), which carries C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) and INFO-F (information focus); and into SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). The structural claim: source transfer in its working form opens onto *spiritual dynamics*, with that spiritual layer leading through ritual dynamics into dynamic functionalism.
